item: The app's packages are imported through src., never bare (row 287)
key_paths: tests/test_config.py; tests/test_cache.py; tests/test_security.py; tests/test_duckduckgo.py; tests/test_merkle_tree.py; tests/test_no_bare_src_package_import.py
summary: Five test files added src/ to sys.path and imported config., utils., services. or crypto. bare, loading a second copy of each package beside src.*; they now import through src. In test_config.py the no_repo_configs fixture patched src.config's Config while the tests called the bare copy's get_config, so the tests meant to run without a configs folder read the repo's; they now run as written and pass. The guard (renamed from test_no_bare_database_import.py) covers every top-level name under src/ in src, tests and scripts by AST: static imports at any depth, import_module, __import__, importorskip and find_spec (bare top-level names included) and dotted patch/setattr string targets including f-strings, behind a prefilter that is tested never to skip a flagged form; test_config now resets the real config singleton before each test as well as after. Test-only, no release line.
